description: Designed and maintained data infrastructure for Vueling, transforming complex operational data into strategic assets. Built ETL/ELT pipelines with Apache Airflow, ingesting from REST APIs, SharePoint, SQL Server and web scraping. Implemented observability via Elasticsearch/Kibana and led CI/CD migration from Jenkins to Azure DevOps.

Technical lead on digital transformation projects at Michelin's CEMA experience center. Replaced physical forms with dynamic Power Apps, designed Power Automate workflows and managed the full project lifecycle. Obtained the Microsoft PL-100 certification during this period.

Developed and maintained low-code solutions to digitize business processes. Built canvas applications with Power Apps and Dataverse, designed automations with Power Automate and handled full project lifecycle from requirements to UAT.

Supported development and maintenance of web applications covering frontend and backend. Resolved incidents and gained hands-on experience with the software development lifecycle in a corporate environment.

Before moving into IT, worked across HR, legal documentation and operations roles — managing payroll, labour contracts, data protection compliance and client processes. This background shaped my approach to automation and data engineering: focused on solving real business problems.
